name: chrome
description: Drive the user's real Chrome browser from the agent via the mcp-chrome extension-based MCP server — reuse login state, manage tabs, monitor network, search history, manage bookmarks, with a built-in semantic tab search.

interface.shortDescription: Drive the user's real Chrome — tabs, history, bookmarks, network.
interface.longDescription: Your agent can work inside your own Chrome browser — the one with your logins, cookies, and extensions already set up. It can open and manage tabs, search your browsing history, organize bookmarks, capture network activity, and even find content across all your open tabs with semantic search. No need for a separate automation browser: your agent uses the Chrome you already have, with your sessions preserved.
defaultPrompt: Find that article I had open earlier in one of my tabs.
Help me organize my bookmarks into folders.
Search my browsing history for a page I visited last week.
